Hi Voat. Today I'm feeling pretty ill so I had to make soup to make me feel better. Soup is also the only thing I can really eat when I'm sick, but I like soups on normal days too just because they're so cheap, healthy and filling.

For this soup I used...

  • 1 large onion
  • 2 carrots
  • 2 potatoes
  • 1 vegetable stock cube
  • Spaghetti (I used gluten free because I have celiac)
  • 1 Parsnip
  • Salt
  • Pepper
  • Extra Virgin Olive Oil
  • Garlic Powder

It's mostly vegetables and then seasoning. Nothing bad goes into the soup and you can season it to your preference. It only takes 10 minutes to prepare your veg, then it's done in half an hour.

It also makes 4 servings, so you can easily feed a family or yourself for a few meals. What's not to love?

Method:

  1. Peel your vegetables and dice your carrots, parsnip and potatoes. Then slice and dice your onion.
  2. Put all of your chopped vegetables into a medium-large pot and the onion into a pan with a splash of extra virgin olive oil on high heat.
  3. Break up a small portion of spaghetti into your pot and then add water so that it's just about covering your veg and cook on high heat.
  4. After about 10 minutes when your onion has softened, add it to the pot. The water should be boiling by now, so reduce it to a fairly low heat and let it boil for around 30 minutes.
  5. Add in any salt and pepper. I used that as well as garlic salt for a nicer flavour.
  6. After the time is up, serve.
